lastCompletedStory.title: On-main ref-only append-record writer + reader + dedup for the typed store

nextStoryContext: US-003 ("Outcome-append writer with WorkerOutcomeKind mapping") builds on this story's appendPatternRecordOnMain/readPatternRecordsFromMain (src/commands/pattern-records.ts). The dedup key is fingerprintPatternRecord(name+description+dir_anchors) -- PatternRecord itself carries no fingerprint field, it is always recomputed. Appending an OUTCOME to an existing record's outcomes[] array is a distinct operation from appendPatternRecordOnMain (which only appends brand-new whole-record JSON lines and dedups on identity): US-003 will need a new writer that reads the store, locates the matching record by fingerprint, appends one PatternOutcome to its outcomes[], and rewrites that one line in place (mirroring removeSuggestionLine's byte-preserve-other-lines approach in suggestions.ts, not appendPatternRecordOnMain's line-append approach). Reuse readPatternRecordsFromMain for the read side and commitTreeToMain (per-attempt FileWritesFn recompute, CAM-300 pattern) for the write side; do not re-invent the CAS retry loop. Unlike suggestions.jsonl (seeded by cam init, missing = structured error), pattern-records.jsonl has no seeding story -- a missing store bootstraps to empty on write (see patterns.md bullet on this). confirmationScore(record) (src/patterns/record.ts, US-001) is what the outcomes[] array feeds; US-004's prune/demotion gate consumes it.
